text:
alice.dev: quick heads-up — I'm kicking a py/ts SDK publish tonight to patch a sync-client timeout regression we started seeing in canary. planning a quiet window 02:00-03:00 UTC. will publish staged wheels + npm tag, then promote if smoke is clean. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ben.platform: noted. please add a rollback dist-tag and keep previous 'latest' pinned until +1h after promotion. i'll watch the dist-tag flip.

carla.releases: saw a couple failing canaries earlier — 401s on auth refresh path. attaching small log excerpt: `ERROR auth: token refresh failed status=401 socket=api.prod`. recommend abort promotion if that shows up again.

deploy-bot: Deploy requested by alice.dev at 1754322050
deploy-bot: Step: upload wheel -> success
deploy-bot: Step: publish npm -> success
deploy-bot: Canary: traffic 5% -> in progress

ryan.docs: i'll prep CHANGELOG + deprecation blurb for the old sync adapter. where do you want the user-facing note to link? migration guide or new adapter docs?

alice.dev: decision update — abort promotion to 'latest' for now. we will roll back npm dist-tag to previous stable and republish a patched build with the timeout fix. commands i'm running: 
```
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.2 latest  # rollback to stable
# build+upload patched wheel
python -m build
twine upload --repository pypi dist/*.whl
```

ben.platform: i'll handle the dist-tag flip at 1754322150 and leave the old version pinned on 'latest' until we confirm 30m of healthy telemetry. also adding a `-rollback` tag as a safety fallback.

carla.releases: re-run quick smoke after tag flip: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' https://api.redwood.example/v1/health` -> 200 now. seems the rollback removed the bad canary. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Dist-tag update complete -> `latest` now -> 1.4.2 at 1754322160

alice.dev: great, thanks everyone. postmortem notes: root cause was default timeout change in the sync adapter that didn't surface in unit tests. action items: add a CI smoke that covers auth refresh loops, add a nightly canary job that hits auth refresh, and include a release checklist item to create a rollback dist-tag before any promotion. assigning: carla.releases (CI smoke), ben.platform (dist-tag automation).

ryan.docs: drafted release notes & deprecation blurb, PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/432 — includes migration steps and the troubleshooting note for 401s.

alice.dev: thanks — will follow up tomorrow in all-hands if the automation work needs more time. :thumbsup:
